proposed_widenings.name: vehicle_object_family
proposed_widenings.justification: The item is a piloted object with its own persistent stat block, movement modes, occupant compartment, and damage handling. Existing magic-item families only cover passive grants, activated abilities, or composites of those, not a controllable vehicle/object subsystem.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The Apparatus of the Crab is a Large object with the following statistics: AC 20; HP 200; Speed 30 ft., Swim 30 ft. (or 0 ft. if the legs aren't extended); Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage.

proposed_widenings.name: lever_control_panel
proposed_widenings.justification: The apparatus exposes ten transient controls with paired up/down outcomes, and one Utilize action can operate up to two controls. That is a stateful command-surface subgraph, not a single passive grant or one-shot activation.
proposed_widenings.evidence: A creature in the compartment can take a Utilize action to move as many as two of the apparatus's levers up or down. After each use, a lever goes back to its neutral position.

proposed_widenings.name: vehicle_environmental_constraints
proposed_widenings.justification: The apparatus tracks sealed compartment air supply, underwater depth tolerance, and recurring pressure damage below a threshold depth. The current surface has no place to model persistent vehicle environmental limits or depth-triggered recurring damage.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The compartment holds enough air for 10 hours of breathing, divided by the number of breathing creatures inside. The apparatus floats on water. It can also go underwater to a depth of 900 feet. Below that, the vehicle takes 2d6 Bludgeoning damage each minute from pressure.

notes: No content file authored. The current surface can represent some leaf mechanics in isolation, but not the unit's actual shape: a reusable piloted vehicle/object with control-state transitions and environmental operation rules.
